facebook.caption:
This place fixes the noise.

Mai Jo Restaurant sits in Ông Lang, away from the main tourist strip. 4.7 stars across 1,815 reviews. That number is earned.

$15-30 a head. Real food. The kind of meal that makes you slow down and actually be somewhere.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
